$player..validate: newData.hasChildren(['name', 'score', 't']) && newData.child('score').isNumber() && newData.child('score').val() >= 0 && newData.child('score').val() < 100000000 && newData.child('name').isString() && newData.child('name').val().matches(/^[A-Z][a-z]+[A-Z][a-z]+[0-9]{2}$/) && newData.child('t').val() <= now

newData.hasChildren(['name', 'power', 'keep', 't']) && newData.child('name').val().matches(/^[A-Z][a-z]+[A-Z][a-z]+[0-9]{2}$/) && newData.child('power').isNumber() && newData.child('power').val() < 100000000 && newData.child('keep').isNumber() && newData.child('keep').val() <= 20 && newData.child('t').val() <= now

$report..validate: newData.hasChildren(['from', 'win', 'loss', 't']) && newData.child('from').val().matches(/^[A-Z][a-z]+[A-Z][a-z]+[0-9]{2}$/) && newData.child('win').isBoolean() && newData.child('loss').isNumber() && newData.child('loss').val() >= 0 && newData.child('loss').val() <= 0.9 && newData.child('t').val() <= now

$player..validate: newData.hasChildren(['game', 'room', 'name', 't']) && newData.child('game').isString() && newData.child('game').val().length <= 32 && newData.child('room').isString() && newData.child('room').val().matches(/^pp-[a-z0-9]+-q[0-9]+$/) && newData.child('name').val().matches(/^[A-Z][a-z]+[A-Z][a-z]+[0-9]{2}$/) && (!newData.child('label').exists() || (newData.child('label').isString() && newData.child('label').val().length <= 40)) && newData.child('t').val() <= now
